scope: Independent read-only asset/provenance check of finalized v8 Web ResourceBundles export. Only this new report was written; no rebuild, runtime/source edits, historical record changes or playback was performed.

historicalBaseline.use: Previously saved v7 and three-track music SHA256/UUID/import-duration records, not regenerated from v8.

mappingMethod: Declared logical path -> compact source-meta UUID -> bundle indexed import/native versions -> full UUID file. Check AudioClip name/extension/duration, exact source/native SHA256, source-master hash and PCM frame format. Scan every export bundle for old UUIDs and every native audio file for duplicate bytes.
limits: This checks asset routing, exact bytes and declared source license, not artistic or human listening acceptance.
Web export is not TapTap Android/device playback, memory, latency or interruption validation.
The 27 preserved sounds intentionally share bytes with retained v7 source files; only one native instance of each is exported. No v7 UUID/import/native file is shipped.
